sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-22 and 2016-11-22, customer account C13487 on card C13487-K1 was targeted by a coordinated fraud syndicate operating via device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080'. Investigation in TigerGraph revealed 114 unauthorized transactions across 52 distinct customer accounts linked to the identical device signature, utilizing emulator spoofing and rotating proxy infrastructure. Transaction 3478561 for $74.96 was executed without cardholder consent. Total suspicious activity associated with this case is $74.96. The primary card has been blocked and reissued, and all 51 connected cards have been placed under enhanced monitoring. This report is filed pursuant to BSA/AML regulations and Policy R6/R9.
